name: Double Down
text: You may play this spell after a conjuration you control with a life value of 1 is destroyed as a result of an attack, spell, ability, or dice power an opponent controls. Place 2 copies of that conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Dream Fracture
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]]: Choose a target opponent that has 1 or more dice in their active pool. Lower 1 die in their active pool one level. Then, deal 1 damage to their target Phoenixborn if they have no dice on their power side in their active pool.

name: Dreamlock Mage
text: Restrict 1: [[side]]: Lower 1 die on its power side in a target opponent's active pool one level.

name: Ensnare
text: You may play this spell after an opponent declares a guard. Deal 2 damage to that target guarding unit or Phoenixborn.

name: Fox Spirit
text:
Keen 1: When this unit comes into play, you may raise 1 die in your active pool one level.

Pounce 2: When this unit is declared as an attacker, add 2 to its attack value for the remainder of the turn if it is targeting an exhausted unit.

name: Hope Everthorn
text: Duplicate: [[side]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[basic]]: Choose a conjuration you control with a life value of 1. Place a copy of that conjuration onto your battlefield. At the end of this turn, destroy that copy.

name: Keepsake
text:
After 1 or more dice in an opponent’s active pool are re-rolled, lowered in level, or changed to a side of your choice, place 1 status token on this spell for each affected die, without exceeding four on this spell.

[[main]], 1 [[illusion:class]]: Discard this spell. Deal damage to a target unit equal to the number of status tokens that were on this spell.

name: Realm Walker
text: Isolate 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, choose a target opponent to place 1 exhaustion token onto an unexhausted unit of their choice that they control.

name: Reimagine
text:
After you pay for a dice power using a [[time:power]] or [[illusion:power]], you may place that die and 1 exhaustion token on this spell if it has no dice on it.

* You may use [[time:power]] or [[illusion:power]] on this spell to pay the cost of reactions.

* Exhaust any dice on this spell during the exhaust dice step of the recovery phase.

name: Summon Fox Spirit
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[illusion:class]]: Place a [[Fox Spirit]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 1: You may change the activation cost of this spell to [[side]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[illusion:class]].

name: Summon Wishing Wing
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[time:class]]: Place a [[Wishing Wing]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 2: Then place 1 status token on that [[Wishing Wing]].

name: Void Pulse
text: You may play this spell after you declare attackers. Deal damage to a target unit an opponent controls equal to the number of attacking units. If that destroyed the unit, draw 2 cards, and then change 2 dice in a target player's active pool to a side of your choice.

name: Wishing Wing
text:
Opportunist 1: When this unit comes into play, if you have a [[time:power]] in your active pool, place 1 status token on this unit.

* Bequest X: When this unit is destroyed, you may draw up to X cards.

* X = the number of status tokens on this unit.
